name: Wave Spinner
summary: A grid of square cells that pulse in a diagonal, centre or plus wave, fading between two theme colours as it passes.
useWhen: An indefinite wait on a page section, card or button where a spinner should stay calm
A loading state that needs theme colours, so it matches the chart palette in both themes
avoidWhen: Waits with a known length, where a progress bar suits better
Inline text loading, where ai-chat/lattice-loader with its label and timer, or a plain skeleton, fits better
